    12  /-!
    13  # Defining a monoid given by generators and relations
    14  
    15  Given relations `rels` on the free monoid on a type `α`, this file constructs the monoid
    16  given by generators `x : α` and relations `rels`.
    17  
    18  ## Main definitions
    19  
    20  * `PresentedMonoid rels`: the quotient of the free monoid on a type `α` by the closure of one-step
    21    reductions (arising from a binary relation on free monoid elements `rels`).
    22  * `PresentedMonoid.of`: The canonical map from `α` to a presented monoid with generators `α`.
    23  * `PresentedMonoid.lift f`: the canonical monoid homomorphism `PresentedMonoid rels → M`, given
    24    a function `f : α → G` from a type `α` to a monoid `M` which satisfies the relations `rels`.
    25  
    26  ## Tags
    27  
    28  generators, relations, monoid presentations
    29  -/
    30  
    31  @[expose] public section
    32  
    33  variable {α : Type*}
    34  
    35  /-- Given a set of relations, `rels`, over a type `α`, `PresentedMonoid` constructs the monoid with
    36  generators `x : α` and relations `rels` as a quotient of a congruence structure over rels. -/
    37  @[to_additive /-- Given a set of relations, `rels`, over a type `α`, `PresentedAddMonoid` constructs
    38  the monoid with generators `x : α` and relations `rels` as a quotient of an AddCon structure over
    39  rels -/]
    40  def PresentedMonoid (rels : FreeMonoid α → FreeMonoid α → Prop) := (conGen rels).Quotient
    41  
    42  namespace PresentedMonoid
    43  
    44  open Set Submonoid
    45  
    46  @[to_additive]
    47  instance {rels : FreeMonoid α → FreeMonoid α → Prop} : Monoid (PresentedMonoid rels) :=
    48    inferInstanceAs <| Monoid (conGen rels).Quotient
    49  
    50  /-- The quotient map from the free monoid on `α` to the presented monoid with the same generators
    51  and the given relations `rels`. -/
    52  @[to_additive /-- The quotient map from the free additive monoid on `α` to the presented additive
    53  monoid with the same generators and the given relations `rels` -/]
    54  def mk (rels : FreeMonoid α → FreeMonoid α → Prop) : FreeMonoid α →* PresentedMonoid rels where
